# Changelog

## 4.4.183

- New desktop shell built with Tauri and Rust, replacing the Qt shell
- Video plays through libmpv inside the app window (macOS)
- The streaming server runs on a bundled Node, so no separate install is needed
- Items you remove from the library and add back now show up as newly added
- Movie/series filter in Library and Discover is a toggle instead of a dropdown
